title: Toworu Miyata's Aoharu Once More BL Manga Gets Light Anime
content: IMAGICA Infos ' new boys-love label BALLOON announced on Thursday that it is producing a light anime adaptation of Toworu Miyata 's Aoharu Once More boys' love manga. Rikako Machida ( Saved by the Ice Cold Prince's Embrace series composition) is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos / Imageworks Studio .
author: ANN

title: Live-Action The Silent Service Reveals New Series' Title, Summer 2027 Debut in Teaser Video
content: Amazon Prime Video Japan started streaming on Thursday a teaser trailer for the new sequel series of the live-action project of Kaiji Kawaguchi 's The Silent Service manga, and revealed the title Chinmoku no Kantai Mezame yo, New York ( The Silent Service : Awaken, New York).
author: ANN

title: 'Dragon Ball Super: Beerus' Reveals Main Staff, Theme Songs, "Super Surge" Promo
content: The official website of the Dragon Ball franchise revealed the main staff, theme songs, "Super Surge" visual (pictured), and promotional video for its new television anime on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sekiro: No Defeat Anime Film's Clip Shows Wolf, Genichiro Ashina's Duel
content: The staff for Sekiro: No Defeat , the new anime based on FromSoftware 's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice game, began streaming a clip from the film on Thursday. The clip shows Genichiro Ashina's duel with Wolf.
author: ANN

title: 'Nippon Sangoku' Anime Sequel Announced
content: Production company Twin Engine announced on Thursday that a sequel to the Nippon Sangoku ( Nippon Sangoku: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun ) television anime is in production. Produced by Studio Kafka , the anime series adapting Ikka Matsuki 's post-apocalyptic drama manga began airing on April 7.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Summer Hikaru Died Manga to End in 2 Chapters
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Mokumokuren 's The Summer Hikaru Died ( Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu ) manga announced on Tuesday that the manga will end in two chapters. The manga's chapter 50 is scheduled to publish on October 13, and chapter 51 is scheduled to publish on October 20.
author: ANN

title: Nippon Sangoku Anime Gets Sequel
content: Twin Engine announced on Thursday that production on a sequel to Nippon Sangoku The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun , the television anime of Ikka Matsuki 's Nippon Sangoku manga, has been green-lit.
author: ANN

title: NIPPON SANGOKU Sequel Anime Announced
content: NIPPON SANGOKU sequel anime has been officially announced two months after the first season’s finale released on June 21. Studio Kafka was in charge of the animation, while the anime was co-produced with Amazon MGM Studios and is available for streaming on Prime Video.
author: Anime Corner

title: Oedo Fire Slayer Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Artist's Illness
content: This year's 40th issue of Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine announced on Thursday that Shinobu Seguchi 's Oedo Fire Slayer ( Hikuidori Ushūboro Tobigumi ) manga adaptation of Shōgo Imamura 's Hikuidori historical novel does not appear in the issue and will go on hiatus at least until the magazine's next…
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Please Save My Earth Series' Teaser Shows Glimpse of Mokuren
content: Amazon Prime Video posted an early teaser trailer for the live-action series of Saki Hiwatari 's Please Save My Earth manga on Thursday. The teaser offers a partial glimpse of Alice Hirose ( Bubble , live-action Silver Spoon , HYOUKA ) as Mokuren.
author: ANN
